name: Alysson
source:
It’s a small world where you can meet the same girl twice in one day. Paul, a thirty-something who has almost given up on love, falls head-over-heels for this beautiful woman.

[From [url=https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/38/alysson]ldjam.com[/url]]
translation:
这是一个小小的世界，一天之内竟能两次遇见同一个女孩。三十多岁、几乎已经放弃爱情的保罗，对这位美丽女子一见倾心。

[来源：[url=https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/38/alysson]ldjam.com[/url]]
